column3: Close to the Hebrew; כָל־ עֵרֶב (“mixed ancestry”) is rendered “the mixed multitude.”
Close to the Hebrew; קָרוֹב (“near, related”) is rendered “allied with.”
Close to the Hebrew; “at the end of days” is rendered “after certain days.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֲסָדַי (“acts of loyalty”) is rendered “good deeds.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְחוּסָה (“have pity”) is rendered “spare me,” and “covenant loyalty” “mercy.”
